steps.eval: (function(){ var s=document.getElementById('cd-splash'); return s? {say: (document.getElementById('cds-say')||{}).textContent, pct:(document.getElementById('cds-pct')||{}).textContent} : 'splash gone already'; })()

(function(){ var b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>/Go to Home/.test(x.textContent)); if(b) b.click(); return {splash: !!document.getElementById('cd-splash'), refreshBtn: !!document.getElementById('cd-refresh-btn'), title: (document.getElementById('cd-refresh-btn')||{}).title}; })()

(function(){ try{ document.querySelectorAll('.cd-display-menu').forEach(m=>{ var b=m.closest('[class*=back]')||m.parentElement; }); }catch(e){} var mr=document.getElementById('modal-root'); document.body.click(); return 1; })()
(function(){ try{ window.__cdSC && __cdSC.toast ? __cdSC.toast('In five minutes: Reading. Finish the line you are on.', 9000) : null; }catch(e){ return 'err '+e; } return 1; })()

(function(){ try{ custodiaPrompt(); }catch(e){ return 'err '+e; } var c=document.querySelector('#custodia-overlay > div'); return c? {cls:c.className, bg:getComputedStyle(c).backgroundColor, btns:[...c.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>b.className)} : 'none'; })()
